title: Count nonunits modulo a prime power
statement: For natural numbers p and a with p prime and 0 < a, the subtype of nonunits in ℤ/p^aℤ has natural cardinality p^(a−1): Nat.card {z : ZMod (p^a) // ¬ IsUnit z} = p^(a−1).
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → Nat.card {z : ZMod (p ^ a) // ¬ IsUnit z} = p ^ (a - 1)
